newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen fluctuating on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen fluctuating on consolidation.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to fluctuate in consolidation on Monday as sentiment remained weak because of last week's reports on first-half corporate results, brokers said.
But they said share prices could rebound after last week's sharp fall. "Trading will be weak. But a technical rebound is likely," said Na Min-ho of Daishin Securities.
The composite index ended 7.37 points lower at 748.41 on Saturday.
Brokers said blue chips would be dull, while some theme-backed small shares would be in demand.
"The direction of the market for today will depend pretty much on whether foreign investors would continue to sell shares of KEPCO," said Choo Hee-yup of Dongwon Securities.
Brokers said foreigners sold about 300,000 shares of KEPCO on Thursday to offset earlier speculative buying.
